newsitem.title: UK: Clinton Cards expects to outstrip forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Clinton Cards expects to outstrip forecasts.

text.p: British greetings card retailer Clinton Cards Plc said on Thursday it was confident of exceeding current market forecasts for the full year after buoyant sales in autumn last year and in the period before Christmas.
"The board is confident of comfortably exceeding current market forecasts," Clinton Cards said in a statement.
Clinton Cards said sales rose 15.2 percent in the five weeks before December 29, 1996. Preliminary results for the year to February 2, 1997 are expected to be released in March.
